bio: While many sailors claim to have the ocean running through their veins, they'll never match up to their fellow Freeborn who actually have gills. It's these aquatic members of the Free Armada who birthed Carchus – a Titan devoted to keeping Amara's seas wild and untamed. Despite Carchus' command of the waves, even it doesn't truly know what lies on the seafloor...
